subject: History
question_text: Which event is most closely associated with the Battle of Adwa in 1896?
option_b: The founding of the League of Nations
option_c: The end of the First World War
option_d: The opening of the Suez Canal
explanation: Ethiopian forces defeated the invading Italian army at Adwa in 1896.

subject: History
question_text: What was a central purpose of the Berlin Conference of 1884–1885?
option_b: To regulate European claims in Africa
option_c: To end the First World War
option_d: To grant independence to African colonies
explanation: European powers agreed on rules for claiming territory in Africa; African peoples were not represented.

subject: History
question_text: Which ancient Ethiopian kingdom was centered at Aksum?
explanation: Aksum was the center of the ancient Aksumite Kingdom in the Horn of Africa.

subject: History
question_text: Which organization was established after the First World War to promote international cooperation?
explanation: The League of Nations was established after the First World War.

subject: History
question_text: What was one major effect of the trans-Saharan trade?
option_a: It connected North and West Africa with Mediterranean markets
option_b: It ended all trade across the Indian Ocean
option_c: It isolated West African states from one another
explanation: Trans-Saharan routes linked West African states and goods with North Africa and Mediterranean trade networks.

subject: History
question_text: Which Ethiopian leader is associated with the country's resistance to Italian occupation during the 1930s?
explanation: Haile Selassie led Ethiopia during the Italian invasion and appealed to the League of Nations.

subject: History
question_text: The Industrial Revolution began first in which country?
explanation: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late eighteenth century.

subject: History
question_text: Which was a major goal of African nationalist movements after the Second World War?
option_c: To end education in local communities
explanation: Nationalist movements sought an end to colonial rule and the achievement of independence.

subject: History
question_text: Which body replaced the League of Nations after the Second World War?
explanation: The United Nations was founded in 1945 after the Second World War.

subject: History
question_text: In which year was the Organization of African Unity (OAU) founded?
explanation: The OAU was founded in Addis Ababa in 1963.

subject: History
question_text: Which factor contributed to the growth of Ethiopian state power in the late nineteenth century?
option_a: The expansion and modernization of the imperial army
option_b: The abolition of all regional administration
option_c: The end of trade with neighboring regions
option_d: The withdrawal of all diplomatic relations
explanation: A stronger, modernized imperial army helped Ethiopian rulers consolidate and defend the state.

subject: History
question_text: What is one reason historians compare information from multiple sources?
option_c: To remove dates from historical accounts
option_d: To ensure every source has the same opinion
explanation: Comparing sources helps historians assess evidence and build more reliable interpretations.
